verdict.rationale: Orama is a programmatic library installed via npm/yarn/pnpm/bun, with code-level create and insertMultiple APIs, so it can plausibly run headlessly in scripts. Orama Cloud also offers official JS/TS, Python and Rust SDKs. However, no evidence explicitly documents CI usage, a CLI, or headless automation workflows. Missing for 10: explicit headless/CI documentation, an official CLI, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), hands-on corroboration of CI automation.
